== Reward ==

<ul><li>  {{:Polar Bear Cloak}}
</li></ul>

== Walkthrough ==

''Karg IceBear wanders the tundra, often passing by the North Tower.''

You say, 'Hail, Karg IceBear'

: Karg IceBear says, 'Hail, traveler! I am Karg of Clan IceBear, lone hunter of the Everfrost Peaks.  Have you seen any polar bears about?'

You say, 'Yes.'

: Karg IceBear says, 'I hunt polar bears and furnish cloaks from their pelts.  They keep you warm in this cold weather.'
 
You say, 'Pelts?'

: Karg IceBear says, 'Have you some polar bear pelts? You know I can furnish warm cloaks from them, and for you I will do it for the measly sum of 5 platinum pieces.'

'''Give him a [[Polar Bear Skin]] and 5 pp to receive your reward.'''

''--You receive a [[Polar Bear Cloak]].--''

== Notes ==
